checks.name: fab_inputs_present
checks.why: ACCEPTANCE J is judged on the mask and paste openings and the drill file, read by an independent parser. One file missing means nothing was measured. **Both sides**: a via is one hole through the whole board and a bottom-side pad is reflowed like a top-side one, so a front-only reading judges half a two-sided assembly (Q84). KiCad plots the bottom layers for a single-sided board too, so a missing B_ file is an incomplete export, not a board without a bottom

checks.source: drill circle vs F_Paste / F_Mask openings (exact signed distance)

checks.name: exceptions_refused
checks.why: J-2: a pad of U_ADS and the zero-via nets are never excused, and neither is an exception without a reason, an approver and a date

checks.name: exceptions_all_used
checks.why: an exception that points at a via the board no longer has is a stale record, and leaving it there can excuse the next via that lands nearby

checks.name: thermal_pad_vias
checks.why: SLUA271 3.4.1 (KS-038, CR-038) says a QFN's exposed pad wants vias on a ~1.0 mm pitch and that they must be plugged. Which pads those are is the vendor's statement about the package, so Core does not infer it from the pad's size: a board whose footprints say nothing is skipped BY NAME, and J-2's count below has counted every via it found

checks.name: bypass_no_via_between
checks.actual: skipped (no nets.bypass_pairs and no nets.decoupling: this board has not said which capacitor serves which device)
checks.why: SBAS499C 12.1 (KS-001, CR-014) [T1]: "Do not place vias between bypass capacitors and the active device." The sentence is about every active device, not about the ADS1299, but which capacitor serves which device is not readable from a netlist -- every capacitor on VDD is on the same net. So the product declares the couples, and a board that has not is skipped BY NAME rather than passed with an empty list (Q233's shape). gates/S4b_routability asks the same question before routing, of a board that carries packs.afe-adc's converter and of no other (Q231)
